periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, angling approximately 45 degrees downward towards the snout on both sides.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a vertical elongation; the height of the patch exceeds the width.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad thickness, covering roughly 30-40% of the visible lateral torso region.
